patch_description: Same idea as before: replace the "mean of k smallest" soft objective with a weighted surrogate `0.5·min + 0.5·mean(5 smallest)` so uphill escapes never sacrifice the true bottleneck while lifting the bottom tail of the triangle-area distribution (which drives the combined score). Also add a secondary acceptance criterion in the final polish: accept when the mean of the 5 smallest areas improves without hurting the strict minimum, freeing the search from single-bottleneck traps. Indentation fixed to match the file exactly.
